overview_description.description: Warpfy acquires e-commerce stores in promising categories and scales this multi-channel systematically into global D2C brands. Taking help of big data approach to launch new products, apply techniques in eCommerce, use different technology platforms to grow them multi-channel, and optimize the supply chain for speed to market, and turn these into superbrands that sell products across global marketplaces like Amazon, Shopify, Shopee, and more.
